verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships an official CLI, installable via `uv tool install crewai`, that can "create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project". The docs also offer a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or other coding agents that installs official CrewAI skills and checks the CLI, so agent-driven scaffolding is explicitly supported. Missing for 10: the exact one-command create syntax and generated project structure are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that a coding agent can scaffold a project end to end.
